attributes.action: Reconnect Wells: Build a New Railway Station for England’s Smallest City
attributes.additional_details: Wells is the only city in England without a railway station, leaving residents, workers and visitors without direct rail access. This limits access to jobs, education and services, and increases car use. A new station would improve connectivity, support the local economy and reduce congestion. I want the UK Government to commit to delivering a train station in Wells and work with local authorities to make it happen.
attributes.background: Build a new train station in Wells, Somerset, to provide essential rail connectivity for residents, commuters, and visitors. Wells is the only city in England without a railway station, which limits access to employment, education, healthcare, and sustainable transport options.

We can’t accept petitions that call for actions relating to a local area.

You could ask your MP to take action on your concerns about this issue, including by asking them to present a public (paper) petition about this.

You can find contact details for your local MP here: https://members.parliament.uk/FindYourMP

And you can find out how to ask your MP to present a public (paper) petition here: https://www.parliament.uk/get-involved/sign-a-petition/paper-petitions/

You could also raise your issue with a local councillor who represents you. You can use this page to find out who your local councillors are, and how to contact them: https://www.gov.uk/find-your-local-councillors
